olivia: Seeing latency drift on H100 FP8 rollout top percentile since ~22:00 UTC. Throughput steady but p99 increased ~45ms. Anyone else?

sam: Yep — saw a matching p99 spike on L40S canary too. Started right after the kernel selector change in the canary group (switched to te-fp8-fast). Attached quick profile.

priya: Can you paste the perf breakdown? Also did KV cache hit rates change at the same time?

olivia: KV hit rate looks stable (98.7%). Profile snippet (GPU kernel breakdown):

```
Kernel breakdown (canary-3):
- matmul_fp8_ngemm     42.1ms (↑30%)
- matmul_fp8_ref       12.3ms
- attention_fused      8.9ms
- kv_replay            2.1ms
Total token loop: 85ms (was ~40ms baseline)
```

sam: Interesting — matmul path dominates. We changed kernel prefs in selector: `priority: [te-fp8-fast, te-fp8-stable, int8-fallback]`

diego: My suspicion: calibration/scaling table drift in TE after the microbatch tweak. If scaling quant params change we can hit slower NGEMM code paths on some shapes/hw. Quick rollback of scaling_table to legacy in canary brought p99 back to normal. Repro command I used: `export TE_QUANT_SCALING=legacy && systemctl restart redwood-serving`

sam: We ran a binary bisection. Toggling `tensor-cores-accel` isolates the regression to the TE math path: tensor-cores=on + te-fp8-fast => spike. tensor-cores=off or te-fp8-stable => p99 normal. Looks like the selector prefers an fp8-ngemm kernel on L40S with te-fp8-fast, but that kernel has a pathological slow path for our sequence lengths. :thinking:

priya: Action items: 1) run microbench for candidate kernels on H100 and L40S (all relevant shapes), 2) add lightweight telemetry for chosen kernel name per request (so we can correlate p99 to kernel selection), 3) pin canary routing to `te-fp8-stable` until we fix selector heuristic.

olivia: I'll run the microbench now and upload flamegraphs + nvtx trace. Temporarily set canary routing policy to prefer `te-fp8-stable` and widen canary sampling. Thanks. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: deploy-alert: rollback initiated on cluster canary-3 by olivia at 3276543240

diego: Created PR to add a fallback heuristic when matmul latency exceeds threshold and to prefer safe kernels for shape ranges we saw in traces: https://git.redwood/infer/rep/PR/7892 — comment/ review requested.

sam: Also propose we add a short synthetic KV-heavy eval (long-context/streaming) to the qa pipeline so kernel diffs surface earlier.

olivia: Agreed. Uploading traces to /artifacts/fp8-bisect/3276543210 and will follow up with flamegraphs.

priya: Leaving notes: - Do not flip te-fp8-fast in global rollout until PR 7892 merged + telemetry added. - Add heatmap for kernel x seq-len x p99 in console.

olivia: Thanks everyone — will post results from microbench in this thread.
